memo.title: Plipkary Mid-Sprint Check
summary_points: Backend APIs for product listing and cart are complete and deployed; payment API is 80% done.
Frontend product listing page is live on staging; cart page is 60% complete and now unblocked.
Payment integration with Razorpay is set up, but webhook handling is pending and due by Thursday.
A critical bug exists in the checkout flow where the success page fails to load after payment.
Testing has completed 40 cases for product listing, uncovering 2 bugs, and cart testing is beginning.
The deadline for all development is April 12th to prepare for the investor demo on April 15th.
key_decisions: All development work must be completed by April 12th for final testing.
The checkout page redirect bug must be fixed by April 9th.
Arun must complete the payment webhook integration by April 10th.
Priya must complete the cart page by April 10th.
blockers: Nithya is blocked by a bug in the payment redirect flow on the checkout page.
Priya was blocked on the cart API response format, but this has been resolved by Vikram.
risks: The checkout page redirect bug is critical and risks the upcoming investor demo if not fixed promptly.
The tight deadline of April 12th for all features leaves little room for unexpected delays before the demo.
dependencies: Arun's webhook completion is dependent on Vikram's code review.
Suresh is waiting for Vikram to provide updated environment variables for the payment gateway.
Nithya's bug fix is dependent on help from Priya.
Lakshmi's cart testing is dependent on Priya completing the cart page.
next_steps: Vikram to send updated environment variables to Suresh within 30 minutes.
Vikram to fix the two bugs reported by Lakshmi by tonight (April 8th).
Vikram to review Arun's webhook code this evening (April 8th).
Nithya and Priya to debug and fix the checkout redirect bug by tomorrow (April 9th).
Arun to complete the webhook handling by Thursday (April 10th).
Priya to complete the cart page by Thursday (April 10th).
Lakshmi to begin testing the cart functionality today (April 8th).
manager_actions: Schedule a final review meeting for April 13th.
highlights: Product listing and cart APIs are complete and deployed to staging.
The product listing page is live on the staging environment.
The staging environment is stable with a functional CI/CD pipeline.

briefing.briefing_title: Plipkary Investor Demo - Critical Path Sync
what_was_discussed: Backend APIs for product listing and cart are complete; payment API is 80% done.
Frontend product listing page is live, but the cart page is only 60% complete and was recently unblocked.
A critical bug is blocking the checkout flow, preventing the success page from loading after payment.
The hard deadline for all development is April 12th to prepare for the investor demo on April 15th.
what_was_decided: All development work must be completed by April 12th for final testing.
The critical checkout redirect bug must be fixed by April 9th.
Arun must complete the payment webhook integration by April 10th.
Priya must complete the cart page by April 10th.
what_to_follow_up: Confirm the critical checkout redirect bug is fixed (Nithya & Priya, due Apr 9th).
Check status of Razorpay webhook completion (Arun, due Apr 10th) and if Vikram's review is done.
Verify cart page is complete and ready for testing (Priya, due Apr 10th).
Confirm Suresh is unblocked with the payment gateway environment variables from Vikram.
open_questions: What is the contingency plan if the checkout bug fix is delayed beyond April 9th?
With the cart page due on the 10th and its testing due on the 11th, is there enough buffer for bug fixes before the April 12th code freeze?
risks_to_watch: The checkout redirect bug is the single biggest risk to the investor demo. Its fix is on the critical path.
The tight deadline of April 12th leaves no room for slippage. Any delay in cart page completion or webhook integration will directly impact QA time.
Vikram has multiple high-priority tasks, creating a potential bottleneck for Arun and Suresh who are dependent on him.
suggested_agenda: Live status check on the checkout redirect bug fix (Nithya).
Progress update on cart page and webhook integration (Priya, Arun).
Confirm all blockers are resolved (Suresh, Lakshmi).
Review QA progress and timeline for cart and payment flow (Lakshmi).
Finalize demo run-through plan and assign roles.
